metadata.description: Computer use in the background for Claude Code: your Android phone over ADB, your Windows desktop apps, your real Chrome. Each plugin starts its open-source MCP server from PyPI with uvx, pinned and locked with hashes.

plugins.name: nexus-android
plugins.description: Android phone over plain ADB (no root, no app): screen, gestures, SMS/RCS, notifications, files, settings. Needs uv and USB debugging; adb is downloaded if missing.

plugins.name: nexus-windows
plugins.description: Windows desktop apps in the background (look, click, type, menus, shortcuts, launch) without taking your mouse, keyboard or foreground. Windows 10/11, needs uv.

plugins.name: nexus-browser
plugins.description: Your real Chrome (your sessions) driven in background tabs: forms, network, dialogs, cross-origin iframes, exports, downloads. Requires the one-time NexusBrowser install (Chrome extension + local bridge, Windows).
